name: Paradise Surf School
summary: Paradise Surf School teaches beginner and intermediate surfers in Barbados and picks the beach each day by the waves. Barbadian surfers Bruce and Dane Mackie also guide longer surf tours for experienced surfers. The school runs paddleboard lessons, a paddleboard and turtle snorkel tour, and board rentals too.
standouts: Surf tours guided by Barbadian pro surfers Bruce and Dane Mackie

trips.title: Beginner/Intermediate Surf Lesson
trips.summary: A two hour shared surf lesson for first timers and improving surfers, taught at a relaxed pace. Instructors work on standing up, paddling and positioning, and catching waves on your own, with boards supplied and refreshments afterwards.
trips.checkNotes: An older Wix booking page on the same site (/service-page/surf-lesson, marked 'not available') lists this lesson as 75 Barbadian dollars and adds rash guard, 1 instructor to every 4 students and transport first come first served; the current lesson pages say $75US, which was used. Lesson beach varies with the waves; no meeting point stated.

trips.title: Private Surf Lesson
trips.summary: A surf lesson for you and anyone you choose to bring, with the beach picked for the day's conditions. The older booking page lists transport, board, rash guard, refreshments and GoPro video from your instructor.
highlights: Just you and your own group
GoPro video taken by your instructor

prices.label: Private
prices.note: Home page price; does not say per person or per lesson

includes: GoPro video taken by your instructor
trips.checkNotes: Price conflict: the home page says Private $120US; the older Wix service page (/service-page/private-surf-lessons) says $100US per person, varying with group size, and shows 100 Barbadian dollars. Used the home page. Duration and inclusions come from that service page. The home page Book Now under Surf Lessons goes to the same FareHarbor item as the shared lesson.

trips.title: Surf Tours
trips.summary: A longer day of surfing for intermediate and advanced surfers on holiday. Barbadian pro surfers Bruce and Dane Mackie take you to the best breaks for that day's swell.
highlights: Guided by Bruce and Dane Mackie
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site; it says to email or call for more info. Price may only be shown in the FareHarbor booking flow (not opened).

trips.title: Paddleboard & Turtle Tour
trips.summary: A 90 minute paddleboard trip along the shore looking for starfish and other sea life, then a swim with the local turtles. It runs from Carlisle Bay or Speightstown, with snorkel gear supplied.

trips.title: Paddleboard Beginner Lesson
trips.summary: A one or two hour introduction to stand up paddleboarding on the west or southwest coast. Experienced riders can also ask about paddle surf sessions.
trips.checkNotes: The Book now button for this lesson goes to the same FareHarbor item (182976) as the surf lesson, so it may open the wrong product. Older Wix service pages list two paddleboard lessons at 80 and 60 Barbadian dollars; the current page in US dollars was used.

trips.title: Paddleboard Rentals
trips.summary: Paddleboards for people who already paddle, by the half or full day. Boards can be delivered on the west and south coasts for rentals of several days.
highlights: Delivery on the west and south coasts for multi-day rentals

offer.text: Multiple day specials, ask the school

trips.checkNotes: Pick-up point for single-day rentals not stated.

trips.title: Surfboard Rentals
trips.summary: Weekly rental of shortboards from Lost and longboards from NSP, from 5 foot 10 to 10 foot. Each board is listed with its size and volume so you can pick one to suit.
highlights: Nine boards listed with size and volume
Same weekly price for every board
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. One FareHarbor link per board (nine boards). Pick-up or delivery arrangements not stated. Board photos on this page are maker product shots and were not used.

checkNotes: The site never gives a base or meeting address; surf lessons move between beaches with the waves and the paddleboard tour runs from Carlisle Bay or Speightstown, so town is null. The site has two booking systems: FareHarbor links on the current pages (used) and an older Wix booking page (/book-online, still template text) with prices in Barbadian dollars that conflict with the US dollar prices on the main pages. The older service pages list mackie_bruce@hotmail.com as a contact. The site also advertises rental cars, accommodation and other activities through a separate email (paradisevacationsbarbados@hotmail.com); these are not marine trips and were left out. A shop page sells two items for pick-up at your lesson (USD$30 and USD$25), item names not shown in the page text.
